messages:
Taylor Nguyen: quick sync — noticed confusion in the invite flow when org has SSO enforcement off. customers expect to see SSO requirement before they add people. current flow: Invite > role select > send > modal says 'some users can't sign in' after sending. propose: move SSO toggle/check earlier and show a live compatibility check next to email input. thoughts?
Ibrahim Noor: agree. moving validation earlier reduces failed invites. microcopy: Next to email input show small inline tag: 'SSO required for this org' or 'No SSO for this user' (when detect domain mismatch). keep it short.
Clara Voss: accessibility: if we show inline compatibility messages, they must be exposed via aria-live=polite. also keyboard users should be able to tab to a 'why can't this user sign in?' link that opens a small dialog.
Mateo Ruiz: UX trade: adding checks increases latency on typing. solution: debounce domain check (300ms) and fall back to a 'check' button if network is slow. include spinner in the inline tag.
Taylor Nguyen: good call. also for role matrix: when an invite is pending, show a clear badge in the matrix row and make it filterable by state (active/invite/pending). customers asked for quick audit.
Ibrahim Noor: audit nav: add a deep link from the invite modal to the Audit Log filtered by email. label it 'View prior access attempts' and open in a new tab. must include UTM-like params and the filter state in URL so logs are reproducible.
Clara Voss: modal accessibility: when that deep link is present, ensure it has rel="noopener" and the button has clear focus styles. for screen readers, announce 'Opens Audit Log in a new tab, filtered by email'.
Mateo Ruiz: copy tweak: 'Require SSO for this org' vs 'Enforce SSO' — let's standardize on 'Enforce SSO' in toggles and 'Require SSO' in docs. add helper text: 'Enforced: members must sign in with your SSO provider.'
Taylor Nguyen: keyboard shortcuts: propose a shortcut to open invite modal from roles page: g then i (g i). keep consistent with other console shortcuts. make shortcuts opt-in and visible in shortcuts modal.
AccessibilityBot: reminder checklist: focus management, aria-live for inline status, dialog role for explanations, contrast >= 4.5:1 for inline tags.
Ibrahim Noor: question on retention: when linking invites to audit snapshots, annotate whether the invite metadata is exportable (CSV) and include invite state with timestamps. legal asked for exportable trails.
Clara Voss: export note: add a checkbox on modal 'Include invite in audit export' default checked for orgs on Dedicated/Private. explain in small text that exports are subject to retention policy.
Taylor Nguyen: action items: Ibrahim -> endpoint for domain check + audit deep-link params; Clara -> a11y copy & live region behaviors; Mateo -> prototype for inline tag and debounce behavior; I'll update Figma and draft unified SSO microcopy. aiming for review Thu EOD.
